title: WMO Weather Code Mapping
description: WMO Weather Interpretation Codes (WW) mapped to human-readable descriptions and emojis for display in the KrishiMitra weather dashboard.

title: Weather Alert Thresholds for Farmers
description: Threshold values used by KrishiMitra to raise weather-specific farming alerts including danger and caution warnings.

alerts.title: Thunderstorm Warning
alerts.description: Lightning and electrical storm active. Seek shelter indoors. Postpone using field machinery.

alerts.title: Heatwave Alert
alerts.description: Extreme temperatures exceeding 40°C. Avoid outdoor labor in peak hours. Ensure adequate crop watering.

alerts.title: Cold Wave Alert
alerts.description: Temperatures dropped below 10°C. Cover frost-sensitive crops or trigger light night irrigation.

alerts.title: Heavy Rain Warning
alerts.description: Heavy localized showers expected. Clear drainage pathways to avoid field flooding.

alerts.title: Strong Wind Warning
alerts.description: High wind velocity exceeding 25 km/h. Postpone foliar spraying; secure crop supports.

alerts.title: Fog Warning
alerts.description: Dense fog limiting visibility. Exercise caution during early morning operations.

title: Air Quality Index (AQI) Descriptions
description: US AQI scale descriptions used in KrishiMitra weather dashboard for farmer air quality awareness.

title: Crop-Specific Weather Advisory Structure
description: JSON structure generated by Gemini AI for crop-specific weather farming recommendations.

metadata.generatedBy: Gemini AI (gemini-2.5-flash via Google Generative Language API)

advisoryFields.advisory: 2-sentence summary of crop health suggestions under current weather conditions
advisoryFields.watering: Irrigation guidelines based on humidity, temperature, and rain likelihood
advisoryFields.pesticide: Pesticide spray recommendations based on rain probability and wind speed
advisoryFields.fertilizer: Fertilizer advice based on weather impact on absorption
advisoryFields.harvest: Harvesting advice based on approaching storms or moisture levels
advisoryFields.riskReason: One brief reason explaining the assigned risk level

metadata.fallbackBehavior: If Gemini API is unavailable, fallback advisories are served based on rainProbability > 50% and humidity > 75% thresholds
